project_name: Seema Enterprise - Digital Manufacturing & E-Commerce Ecosystem
design_freedom: HIGH - Hybrid Ecosystem (Retail Elegance + High-Density B2B Manufacturing Admin)

color_palette.theme: Charcoal, Warm White, Brushed Silver & Champagne Gold

font_pairings.display_heading: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, or Outfit (Serif / Architectural Sans for luxury & industrial grandeur)
font_pairings.body_ui: Plus Jakarta Sans or Inter (clean, high-density readability for catalog & admin tables)

scale_rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale_rules.caption_label: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-champagne_gold

typography.hierarchy_gap_rule: Heading to subheading gap must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps. Ensure tight letter spacing on titles above 32px.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing System - 2x to 3x standard padding for luxury retail, dense compact layout for Admin.

bento_grid_modes.mode_a_marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 md:gap-12 with asymmetric spans (8-col hero, 4-col spotlight)
bento_grid_modes.mode_b_admin_dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6 with strict data correlation and scanability

spacing_and_layout.container_padding_rule: Containers with solid borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to eliminate edge text collision.
spacing_and_layout.navigation_header: Fixed/Sticky Header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-charcoal_primary/85 or bg-warm_white/85 (NEVER 100% transparent). z-index: 50 with top padding compensations.

surface_and_materials.tracing_beam: Subtle animated 1px golden borders for featured products and high-tier wholesale cards.
surface_and_materials.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-slate-900/80 with 1px border-white/20 for floating menus & drawers.
surface_and_materials.card_styles: Cardless or minimal 1px border (#E2E8F0 light / #27272A dark) with micro hover lift (-translate-y-1) and soft ambient shadow.

ecommerce_retail.hero: Animated slideshow with luxury bathroom interior visuals, gold CTA buttons, and key USP counters (25+ Yrs, 100% SS-304 Grade, GST Ready).
ecommerce_retail.mega_menu: Interactive category showcase (Bathroom Accessories, SS Towel Racks & Rails, Sanitary Fixtures, Precision Fasteners, Brass & SS Hinges).
ecommerce_retail.product_listing: Faceted filter bar (Material, Finish, Price, In-Stock), grid/list toggle, instant search, and SKU badge.
ecommerce_retail.product_detail: Variant switch (Brushed Silver, Rose Gold, Matte Black, Chrome), Wholesale MOQ tier discount table, 360/gallery view, and instant quotation modal.
ecommerce_retail.cart_drawer: Slide-out side drawer with free shipping threshold progress, item MOQ validator, and quick checkout link.

features: Quick Order Matrix by SKU list & CSV upload
Dealer Tier Discounting (Gold, Platinum, Distributor pricing)
Request Formal Performa Invoice / Quotation Generator
Download CAD / Technical Spec Sheet PDF button
Executive Analytics (Sales volume, GST breakdown, top selling SS SKUs, wholesale approval queue)
Product & Variant Pricing Engine (MRP, Dealer Price, Bulk Tier Pricing)
Wholesale Dealer Approvals workflow (Pending, Verified, Credit Limit Allocation)
Quotations & GST Invoicing System (Tax calculation, PDF print preview, Status: Sent, Approved, Paid)

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: CRITICAL: Every interactive button, link, tab, input, table row, filter, and metric card MUST have a descriptive data-testid (e.g., data-testid='checkout-button', data-testid='sku-input').
accessibility_and_testing.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion in Framer Motion components.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text satisfies APCA / WCAG AA standard against Charcoal (#1E2024) and Warm White (#F9F8F6).

instructions_to_main_agent: Codebase uses React with JavaScript (.js and .jsx files). Do NOT output TypeScript .tsx code.
Always import icons from 'lucide-react' which is pre-installed.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (located in src/components/ui/sonner.tsx or import { toast } from 'sonner').
Ensure all components are responsive (mobile-first approach).
Ensure explicit hover text color is set whenever hover background color is applied.
Ensure dropdowns and dialogs have solid or backdrop-blur backgrounds — NEVER 100% transparent.
Integrate seamless switching between E-Commerce Storefront, Wholesale Portal, and Admin Panel using header role switch or navigation tabs.
